- Initial release of the livestock feeding and drinking behavior monitoring skill.
- Supports analysis of fixed-camera feeder and waterer videos/images to quantify feeding duration, feeding bouts, and drinking frequency.
- Provides structured reports, baseline comparisons, and automatic anomaly alerts for livestock behavior.
- Includes robust privacy, data security measures, and precise historical report querying via cloud API.
- Available in both English and Chinese, with detailed usage workflows and requirements.
